description:
Role

The Acquisition.com Advisory Practice (AP) aims to be the most trusted advisory firm for small and medium businesses, guiding clients through a defined, multi-year journey. Marketing begins that relationship. As CRO Funnel Lead, you own conversion rate optimization across the post-click experience, turning first impressions into qualified conversations.

You are a builder who tests. You diagnose friction, form a hypothesis, design and build the variant, verify tracking, read results honestly, and apply what you learn across all AP funnels. Your scope includes opt-in pages, lead magnet and quiz funnels, webinar registration, booking flows, video sales letters (VSLs), long-form workshop sales pages, and relevant website pages.

Reports to the Head of Marketing, Advisory Practice.

Responsibilities

  • Own the experimentation roadmap across all AP funnels, from intake and prioritization through hypothesis, build, QA, measurement, readout, and iteration. Tie each test to a diagnosed problem and a defined metric.

  • Manage concurrent experiments across multiple live funnels, prioritizing tests by expected impact, available traffic, and measurement readiness.

  • Design pages and variants in Figma; build and deploy in Webflow, HubSpot, and Vercel, including forms, embeds, redirects, scheduler integrations, and custom code where needed.

  • Build and optimize lead magnet funnels end to end, including landing pages, forms, tracking, and qualification questions, in partnership with copy, sales, and RevOps.

  • Maintain tracking events, pixels, UTMs, mobile functionality, and page speed. Complete launch QA, verify forms and tracking after release, and resolve issues.

  • Own the post-click performance dashboard and weekly readout, reporting conversion by funnel step, device, and traffic source. Share wins, losses, inconclusive results, and next decisions.

  • Implement validated winners, update documented controls, and apply transferable learnings across relevant funnels. Maintain test history and page standards so the team can see what is live and why.

  • Partner with the Paid Acquisition Lead on landing-page selection and tracking accuracy, and with lifecycle, copy, sales, and RevOps on the full funnel. Direct outside vendors when needed.

  • Use AI in daily build and analysis work to generate variants, synthesize heatmaps and session recordings, and draft short test copy. Review and validate outputs before use.

  • Own the testing and funnel analytics tool stack within the approved marketing budget, adding tools when a measured problem justifies them.

Requirements

  • Approximately 4–8 years in CRO or growth marketing, with examples of pages you personally designed, built, and tested and the outcomes.

  • Independent experience building and deploying conversion-focused pages, including forms, integrations, and custom code where needed. Prior experience with Webflow, HubSpot, and Vercel is preferred; comparable experience is welcome where skills transfer.

  • Strong visual hierarchy, mobile-first design, and concise copywriting for headlines, calls to action, and forms. Able to create clean, on-brand pages independently.

  • Ability to form clear hypotheses, assess sample size and uncertainty, manage concurrent experiments across multiple funnels, and report losses and inconclusive results honestly.

  • Practical experience with GA4, heatmaps or session recordings, attribution platforms such as Hyros, and scheduler integrations such as iClosed or comparable tools.

  • Demonstrated use of AI to accelerate page building and experimentation, with examples of how you review and validate outputs.

  • Experience in direct response, education, coaching, events, or other businesses where funnels feed a sales team is a plus.

Results

  • Move approved briefs and prioritized tests into live pages in hours or days, with tracking verified and launch QA completed.

  • Maintain a prioritized testing program across AP funnels, with a documented hypothesis, control, baseline, and readout for each experiment.

  • Drive measurable conversion improvement in priority lead magnet, application, and booking flows against agreed baselines and quarterly targets, while maintaining lead-quality standards agreed with sales and RevOps.

  • Keep test reporting current and share it weekly so the team knows what is live, what was learned, what was implemented, and what comes next.

  • Launch new workshops and lead magnet funnels on proven controls, on time, with forms, events, pixels, and booking flows verified before and after launch.

  • Increase useful testing throughput and reduce build and analysis time through AI, while maintaining page quality and measurement accuracy.

Location

  • Remote, USA

  • Some light travel to Las Vegas may be required

Compensation

  • $125,000 - $165,000 base salary + 15% bonus.

  • The salary range may be inclusive of several levels that would be applicable to the position. Final salary will be based on a number of factors including, level, relevant prior experience, skills, and expertise.

Benefits:

We offer a comprehensive, evolving benefits package designed to support your health, family, and wellbeing. Some key offerings:

  • Flexible Unlimited Paid Time Off and Company-wide Holidays

  • Employer sponsored Medical, Dental, & Vision plans

    • $1,950 annual Employer HSA contribution

    • FSA options including dependent care

    • Employee assistance program and mental health resources

  • Employer match program for 401(k), eligible for both Traditional and Roth accounts

  • $1,200 annual wellness reimbursement through JOON that supports health, family care, pet care, fitness, and more!

  • For local or visiting team members, enjoy access to a state of the art gym at our HQ in Las Vegas

* Benefits eligibility applies only to full-time exempt roles.

ACQ Core Values:

Our core values are the heart and soul of this incredible company. The right person for this role will appreciate each of these values, personally subscribe to them, and understand why each is critical to having a great business.

Competitive Greatness

Be at your best when your best is needed. Enjoyment of a hard challenge. Those who have the drive to constantly improve, the superior intellect and long term commitment to see incremental improvements become compounding returns.

Sincere Candor

Have the self awareness to accurately perceive and communicate hard truths that improve others and self, the courage to do so, and the humility to accept them, even when it hurts. Nothing great can be built without feedback: internally or externally.

Unimpeachable Character

Be the type of person with whom people are always proud to associate, personally and professionally. We look for true alignment of thoughts, words, and actions towards a goal worth pursuing.
